candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — evidence-based protocol development
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize evidence-based practice as integration of best available evidence with clinical expertise in care and protocol decisions.

options.B: Practice based only on unit tradition
options.C: Research use that is separate from clinical decision-making
options.D: A protocol process that excludes clinical expertise

candidate.rationale: AHRQ defines evidence-based practice as healthcare guided by thoughtful integration of the best available scientific knowledge with clinical expertise. AHRQ also notes that evidence can be translated into practice-wide protocols. A is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Evidence-based practice integrates best available scientific knowledge with clinical expertise, and evidence can be translated/customized into practice protocols.

candidate.source_locator: Evidence-Based Practice definition; Key Driver 1 — translation of evidence into practice-wide protocols
